source.title: ACR Practice Parameter for Communication of Diagnostic Imaging Findings (summarized)
source.note: Checklist items summarize the report components the ACR practice parameter describes. Confirm against the current document.

items.label: Clinical indication or history
items.guidance: State the reason for the exam and relevant clinical history.

items.label: Procedure and technique
items.guidance: Describe the examination performed, views or protocol, and contrast use.

items.label: Comparison studies
items.guidance: Name the prior studies compared, or state that none were available.

items.label: Findings
items.guidance: Describe the findings using standard anatomic terms.

items.label: Impression or conclusion
items.guidance: Give a concise impression with a specific diagnosis or differential when possible.

items.label: Limitations
items.guidance: Note factors that limit the study, when present.

items.label: Recommendations or follow-up
items.guidance: Give follow-up or additional imaging recommendations when appropriate.

items.label: Communication of critical findings
items.guidance: Urgent or unexpected findings must be communicated directly to the ordering clinician and the communication documented (who, when, how).
